brief:
Yisrael Beiteinu and Likud have opened negotiations to form a unity government, Shehab Wire reported, as tensions escalate over the presidency between Gadi Eisenkot and Benjamin Netanyahu. The two parties are attempting to establish a coalition while sidelining Arab support for any minority administration.

The leadership disagreement centers on who would hold the presidency in a united cabinet, with both Eisenkot and Netanyahu staking claims to the role. Efforts are underway to prevent Arab political support from becoming decisive in government formation.

title: Yisrael Beiteinu and Likud begin unity government talks amid leadership dispute
